title: Site editor
description: Site-editor adapter: iframes `site-editor.php` with chrome hidden. v2 native mount in flight.

hideEditorChrome.description: Strip the block editor's own hub/sidebar/header so the canvas renders as a chrome-less decoration. Only preview/embed surfaces should set this; the default takeover Editor screen leaves it false so the site editor keeps its native browse→edit flow and the user's persisted core/preferences view.

documentation.purpose: Stable identifier for the WordPress Site Editor screen, currently fronted by an iframe pointing at `site-editor.php`. Behind the namespace, the implementation is a one-line delegation to `IframeApp` so authors can target `core:site-editor` in workspace.json today and inherit the native `@wordpress/edit-site` mount when it lands in a v2.x release — without touching their config.

states.renders: Full-bleed iframe with the wp-admin shell (admin menu, admin bar, footer) hidden by the injected CSS. The site editor's own chrome (hub, navigation sidebar, header) stays intact and honors the user's persisted `core/preferences` view; only `config.hideEditorChrome: true` strips it (preview/embed surfaces).

interactions.effect: IframeApp renders `<iframe src="site-editor.php">` and injects the wp-admin shell-hide CSS on load. Editor-chrome hiding is opt-in via `config.hideEditorChrome`.

a11y.focus-management: Iframe owns its own focus tree.

constraints.note: When `config.hideEditorChrome` is set, hides `edit-site-layout__sidebar*` + `edit-site-site-hub` + `edit-site-layout__header-container`; rev with each WordPress release. Verify the preview/Style Book canvas layout after upgrades. The default Editor screen does NOT apply these selectors (see #253).

Top-of-file comment in `SiteEditorApp.js` lists five blockers: preferences-store collision (with `core:appearance-preferences`), command-palette double-registration (edit-site ships its own commands), full-screen-mode CSS, hash-router collision, and missing `@wordpress/edit-site` from BUNDLED_PACKAGES. All five must be resolved before native mount can land.
Authors target `core:site-editor` (not `core:iframe-fallback` with a hand-rolled URL) so the native-mount path can land in a v2.x release without workspace.json migrations.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Loading indicator — inherited from `core:iframe-fallback` (sibling app that this app delegates to). WPDS 0.12 has no Spinner port.
